snippet.title: Baito Fight!! - Steam Next Fest Preview Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3852160/Baito_Fight_Parttime_Devil_Hunter/

Relax in routines of everyday life and a part-time job hunting devils, in Baito Fight!!: Part-time Devil Hunter, a daily life sim JRPG for PC, Max, Linux, and the Playdate handheld console.
You play as Anansi, an ex-baseball player who's recently moved into a new apartment building, only to find that trouble has followed him there.

Fight devils in turn-based RPG combat with a realtime defensive batting mechanic!!

Earn money to spend on convenience store runs, unlocking new powers, and paying off your overdue rent!!

Befriend friendly and quirky neighbors that live in and around your apartment building!!

Every new day you play the game, the in-game world advances forward with you!!

Discover new side quests and story lines with branching paths, as your neighbor's lives move forward in time!!

Solve the mystery behind the devil infestation in your neighborhood!!

Pet the cat!!

WISHLIST ON STEAM TODAY!!
DEMO OUT DURING NEXT FEST!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3852160/Baito_Fight_Parttime_Devil_Hunter/
